name: print-social-blue-rounded-list-week-celebration-activities-lineup
title: Week Celebration Activities Lineup Flyer
whatItIs: A pale portrait flyer with a logo presenter line, a heavy blue title 'SCC Week Celebration', 'Activities Lineup' and six rounded bars listing dates and events in white type, one bar in gold for the main conference, with social handles at the base and a blue arc at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Uniform bars make a schedule easy to scan, and the single gold bar marks the highlight.
techniques: Date block with a vertical divider in each bar
Uniform rounded blue bars stacked evenly
One gold bar as the highlight
Light streak overlays on the blue for sheen

vocabulary.definition: A rounded strip showing a date and an event.
One bar in a different colour to mark the main event.
A large number and month set apart by a rule.
